officialText:
If a license or certificate of competence expires, the individual may apply for late renewal of the license or certificate of competence within one (1) year of the date of its expiration without examination but subject to applicable late renewal fee.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
